title: Dyson Black Friday deals 2026 UK: prices to wait for
description: Today's Dyson vacuum and hair tool prices next to last year's Black Friday lows, so you know which deals are real and which to wait on.
intro:
**The Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute is £349.99 at Argos and John Lewis today, which matches last Black Friday's best price and is the lowest PriceSpy has recorded.** The V15 Detect Absolute is also at its tracked low of £479.99 at Argos, so the two most popular Dyson vacuums are already at Black Friday prices.

Other models are less convincing: the V11 now costs more than the V12, and the V8 is still above last year's £199. These prices were last checked on Argos, John Lewis, AO, Very and Dyson's own site on 14 November 2026.

deals.name: Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Down from £429.99 on 12 November. £349.99 matches Black Friday 2025 and PriceSpy's lowest; John Lewis is the same, and Dyson's own site is £399.99. The best-value Dyson right now.

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: More suction and a bigger bin than the V12, for larger homes, carpets and pets. AO and Very are £479 too, and that's the lowest PriceSpy has tracked, right at the bottom of our target range.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Cyclone Cordless Vacuum (2026)
deals.note: The cheapest current Dyson stick vacuum we found today. The V8 Advanced reached £199 last Black Friday, so there may be another £40 to come.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Absolute Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: The V8 with extra tools. The £399.99 'was' price is generous, and the Very V8 Cyclone is £11 less, so only pick this if you want the extra heads.

deals.name: Dyson Gen5detect Absolute Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's most powerful stick vacuum, with the longest claimed battery life (up to 70 minutes). John Lewis no longer stocks it, so Dyson is the place to buy. Only worth it for a big house; the V15 does most of the job for £120 less.

body:
## Dyson prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the prices Dyson's most popular models reached around Black Friday 2025, or their lowest in the last six months. If you see one at or below this figure, it's a real deal.

- **V8 Advanced:** £199 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **Cyclone V10 Total Clean:** £279 (Currys, Black Friday 2025)
- **V11 Extra:** about £337 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V12 Detect Slim Absolute:** £349 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V15 Detect Absolute:** about £450 to £480
- **V15s Detect Submarine:** £599
- **V16 Piston Animal:** under £590 (six-month low)
- **Airwrap i.d.:** £329
- **Supersonic:** around £200 to £210

Which? also publishes its own "genuine saving" lines. Its threshold for the V15 is under £550, the V12 under £449 and the V8 Animal under £329. Treat those as the minimum: anything above them isn't really a deal.

## When does Dyson's Black Friday sale start?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**. Last year Dyson's own sale was already running by the end of October, almost a month early, and ran to around Cyber Monday. Dyson's deals page already has £100 to £200 off selected models. Expect the main cuts to land before 27 November and run to Cyber Monday (30 November). John Lewis, Currys, Very, Argos and Boots usually match or slightly undercut Dyson within a day or two.

## Buy from Dyson or a retailer?

On 14 November the retailers were cheaper on vacuums: Argos and John Lewis have the V12 Detect Slim Absolute at £349.99 against £399.99 at Dyson, and Argos, AO and Very have the V15 Detect at about £479. Dyson's own site still has some models the shops don't, such as the Gen5detect. A few things make Dyson's own site worth checking:

- **Two-year guarantee** on vacuums, hair tools, purifiers and fans when you buy new.
- **Price-match refund:** Dyson says it will refund the difference if you find the same product cheaper at an eligible UK retailer within 35 days.
- **Bundles and personalisation** you can't get elsewhere. Just check the 'was' price on a bundle: the V15 bundle's £699.99 includes extra tools, so the saving is smaller than it looks.

**Refurbished:** Dyson's refurbished store usually takes £80 to £100 off, but you only get a one-year guarantee and most items were out of stock when we checked.

## Which Dyson vacuum should you buy?

**Small flat or mostly hard floors:** the V12 Detect Slim is light and easy to carry upstairs. It's £349.99 today, matching last Black Friday, which makes it the best-value Dyson right now.

**Bigger house, carpets or pets:** the V15 Detect has more suction, a longer battery and a laser that shows up dust on hard floors. It's £479.99 at Argos today, at its lowest tracked price, so this is a good time to buy.

**Lots of hard floors:** the Submarine models mop as well as vacuum. The V15s Detect Submarine was £599 on 28 October, matching last year's low; check it's still that price before buying.

**On a budget:** an older V8 or V10 at around £200 to £280 still does a good job. Skip the V11 for now: at £429 at AO it costs more than the V12 Detect Slim.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday for a Dyson?

Not for the V12 Detect Slim or V15 Detect: both are already at their lowest tracked prices (£349.99 and £479.99). For the V8, waiting may save you around £40. Hair tools weren't rechecked this time, so compare them against the target prices above.

### Are Dyson Black Friday discounts real?

Mostly, but the 'was' prices are high and bundles can make savings look bigger than they are. Compare against the target prices above rather than the percentage off.

### Is Amazon cheaper for Dyson?

Sometimes for hair tools: the Supersonic dropped to £199 there last year. For vacuums, John Lewis, Currys and Very were usually cheaper or the same.

### Dyson or Shark?

Shark is usually cheaper and has a longer warranty if you register it; Dyson is lighter and has the dust-sensing extras. Our [Shark vs Dyson cordless guide](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) compares them model by model, and the [Shark Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide has Shark prices.

See also [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
